name: course-lecture-notes
description: Turn a university lecture or tutorial (slides in DEVONthink) into complete, self-contained teaching notes in Anki-ready concept blocks, linked to the course textbook. Use when he asks for a study guide or study notes for a lecture or tutorial (often one he missed), to learn a lecture, or to send the blocks of a finished guide to Anki. Not for marking up a paper (paper-premark) or drawing one standalone figure (scientific-figures).
